text: People: Acme Infotech ended FY2025-26 with a workforce of 169,515 employees. Voluntary attrition was 18.7 percent, down from 20.7 percent in the previous year, as retention programmes took effect.

Strategy: In FY2025-26 Acme Infotech concentrated its investments on generative AI platform engineering and automation of delivery pipelines. Management expects these areas to drive the next phase of growth and has realigned its leadership structure around them.

Risk management: The principal risks identified by Acme Infotech are currency volatility, dependence on a few large clients and delivery cost inflation. The audit committee reviews mitigation plans every quarter.
Dividend: The Board of Acme Infotech recommended a final dividend of Rs 38 per share for FY2025-26, subject to shareholder approval at the annual general meeting.
Deal momentum: Total contract value of large deal wins in FY2025-26 reached USD 6,971 million, with several multi-year renewals in banking and retail.
Governance: The board of Acme Infotech held six meetings during FY2025-26. All independent directors met the criteria of independence prescribed under the listing regulations.
Sustainability: Acme Infotech continued its programmes on energy efficiency, responsible sourcing and community education. Detailed environmental disclosures follow the voluntary reporting framework.
Outlook: Demand for technology services remains healthy but clients continue to scrutinise discretionary budgets. Acme Infotech will keep investing in skills and delivery tooling.
